sentences.en: I am looking for a new jacket.
What size do you usually wear?
I normally wear a medium.
Do you have this in a larger size?
Can I try it on?
The fitting rooms are over there.
This shirt feels too tight.
The sleeves are a little long.
I prefer a loose fit.
Does this come in black?
I like the blue one better.
The fabric is soft and comfortable.
Is this made of cotton?
It is perfect for warm weather.
I need something for a formal event.
These trousers match the jacket.
The shoes are too small.
Could I try the next size up?
These shoes fit perfectly.
Is this item available online?
sentences.ar: هل هذا المنتج متوفر عبر الإنترنت؟

sentences.en: How much does this sweater cost?
It is a little over my budget.
Are there any discounts today?
This one is on the clearance rack.
sentences.ar: هذه القطعة في قسم التخفيضات النهائية.

sentences.en: I will take the grey shirt.
Could you remove the security tag?
Can I return it if it does not fit?
sentences.ar: هل أستطيع إرجاعه إذا لم يناسبني؟

sentences.en: Keep the receipt just in case.
Do you offer gift wrapping?
I am buying this as a gift.
What color would you recommend?
This style looks great on you.
I am happy with my choice.
Thank you for your help today.

sections.heading: A new situation
paragraphs: Dina was learning how to handle clothes and sizes in everyday English. The goal was to communicate clearly and politely.
